page_title: MNU 2-2 LIV | Manchester Utd v Liverpool 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
90+7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Liverpool, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+7' Casemiro (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Anthony Taylor and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

90+7' Antony (Manchester United) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Caoimhin Kelleher pulls off an easy save.
90+6' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Andre Onana comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90+5' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+4' Antony (Manchester United) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+4' The rebound finds Luis Diaz (Liverpool) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
90+3' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Mason Mount (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.
90+1' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
90+1' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
89' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
89' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Anthony Taylor had an easy-decision to make.
85' Substitution. Mason Mount (Manchester United) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Kobbie Mainoo walks off.
84' 2 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Andre Onana no chance!
83' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
82' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. It's a penalty for Liverpool!
81' Antony (Manchester United) commits a rough foul. Anthony Taylor stops the game and makes a call.
80' Andre Onana (Manchester United) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
80' Substitution. Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) on for Alejandro Garnacho.
79' Unbelievable miss! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
79' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Andre Onana anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
78' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
77' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
77' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) was waiting for the ball on the edge of the box and produced a powerful volley directed low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
76' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
74' Willy Kambwala (Manchester United) has tested the patience of referee Anthony Taylor and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
74' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Caoimhin Kelleher is alert and denies him.
72' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

72' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
71' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
69' Today's match ends for Wataru Endo who will be replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
69' Here comes a substitution. Darwin Nunez is given a rest as he is replaced by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).

67' 2 - 1 Goal! Aaron Wan-Bissaka shows great vision to find Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
66' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is being substituted because of an injury. Erik ten Hag sends Antony on the pitch.
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is replacing Dominik Szoboszlai.
66' Here is a change. Conor Bradley is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
63' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
63' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
61' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Andre Onana comes off the line to clear the ball away.
60' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) offside.
59' Anthony Taylor has a clear sight and sees a foul from Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
59' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Caoimhin Kelleher intercepts the ball.
58' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
57' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
56' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
56' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.
55' Manchester Utd have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
55' The corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.
55' Luis Diaz plays a pass to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the right post.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

53' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.

50' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Caoimhin Kelleher just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
49' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
48' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' The ball breaks to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) after a scramble in the box, but his first-time effort is immediately blocked.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+2' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Liverpool win a corner.
45+1' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Andre Onana comes off his line to gather the ball.
43' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

42' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
42' Caoimhin Kelleher displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
37' 0:12 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
36' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.
35' That's unlucky! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
34' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

34' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the left post. It would have probably ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Andre Onana and his brilliant save. Liverpool have a corner.
34' The resulting corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

33' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Andre Onana has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
31' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
30' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
27' Casemiro (Manchester United) gets on the end of the free kick and unleashes a header. The effort is not accurate enough and goes well wide of the left post.
27' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester Utd have a free kick.
26' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared.
26' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
25' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool).
24' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
23' 0 - 1 GOAL - 0:1! The corner comes over and Darwin Nunez flicks on with his head to Luis Diaz (Liverpool), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
22' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
22' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
20' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) fails to trouble the keeper from distance as his shot goes well wide of the right post.
18' Andrew Robertson slides a brilliant pass into Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
18' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
17' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
14' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner with a short pass.
13' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.
11' What a chance that is! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar.
11' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
10' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
9' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
9' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Manchester Utd get a corner.
8' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
7' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner but it's cleared. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Conor Bradley (Liverpool) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
7' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Manchester Utd will take a corner.
6' The ball is cleared after Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the right side of the goal, but Andre Onana is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
2' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
